description: An injective map into a well-ordered type induces a well-order on its domain by comparing the images.
signature:
Function.Injective.isWellOrder.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (r : β → β → Prop) {f : α → β}
  (hf : Function.Injective f) [IsWellOrder β r] : IsWellOrder α (Function.onFun r f)
